correctness.rationale: PASS: Global rate-r resets yield the finite-state resolvent r∫exp(-rt)P_t(full,.)dt and a unique stationary law. As r↓0, coalescence on a finite connected ring reaches one surviving symmetric walker, so the Abel-limit covariance of distinct occupancy sites is -1/N². For nonadjacent vacancies i,j, a single jump gives 2t+O(t²) per vacancy and precisely eight ordered two-event histories produce both vacancies, yielding joint vacancy probability 4t²+O(t³); exponential age mixing gives E(V_i V_j)=8/r²+O(r^-3) and Cov=4/r²+O(r^-3)>0 for large r. At N=4, independently assembled all 15 nonempty-state generator transitions and solved the exact stationary system symbolically without using the package code; the displayed near/opposite rational functions and unique positive opposite-covariance root 0.530754559719 agree exactly. Positive-root uniqueness follows from polynomial derivative positive for r>0; N>=4 universal only guarantees existence of a nonadjacent sign crossing, not its uniqueness.
